_doc.zh: 真人朗读的示例片段：LibriSpeech dev-clean 里的 10 句（男女各 5 位说话人，每人一句），24 kHz、单声道、16 位，带音素时间线（格式与 /api/tts 和 tts-demo 相同）。时间线来自 Montreal Forced Aligner 的自动对齐（Lugosch 2019），不是人工标注。text 是 LibriSpeech 的转写（大写改成句首大写，没有标点）。source.offsetS 是剪掉开头静音的秒数。coverage 是每段里双唇音（P B M）、唇齿音（F V）、圆唇音（UW OW W）和开口元音（AA AE AO）的个数。benchmark 和各段的 bench 由 bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts bench 写入：两种带动方式（按音素、按音频分析）的下颌角相关和双唇音处的唇间隙。
_doc.en: Real read-speech example clips: 10 utterances from LibriSpeech dev-clean (5 female and 5 male speakers, one each), 24 kHz, mono, 16-bit, with a phoneme timeline (the format of /api/tts and tts-demo). The timelines come from automatic Montreal Forced Aligner alignments (Lugosch 2019), not hand labels. `text` is the LibriSpeech transcript (upper case turned into sentence case, no punctuation). source.offsetS is the leading silence trimmed off, in seconds. `coverage` counts the bilabials (P B M), labiodentals (F V), rounded sounds (UW OW W) and open vowels (AA AE AO) in each clip. `benchmark` and each clip's `bench` are written by bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts bench: the jaw-angle correlation of the two drive modes (by phoneme, by audio analysis) and the lip gap at bilabials.

generatedBy.command: bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts fetch && bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts build && bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts bench

rules.zh: 每段至少各有一个双唇音、唇齿音、圆唇音和开口元音；没有 spn 和 <unk>；对齐的词与转写一致；没有长于 0.4 秒的非停顿音；剪掉首尾静音（各留 0.25 秒）后 3–4.5 秒；排除含暴力、宗教等词的句子；每位说话人最多一句；按双唇音和唇齿音的个数排序。
rules.en: Every clip has at least one bilabial, labiodental, rounded sound and open vowel; no spn or <unk>; the aligned words match the transcript; no non-pause phone longer than 0.4 s; 3–4.5 s after trimming silence at both ends (0.25 s kept); sentences with words of violence, religion and the like are left out; one sentence per speaker at most; ranked by the number of bilabials and labiodentals.

method.zh: 由 bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts bench 写入（见 tools/voice/librispeech-bench.ts）。男性人体；按音素用说话的缺省风格"正常"。jawR：两种方式下颌角（每秒 100 帧）的 Pearson 相关，全部帧；jawRSpeech：只算说话的帧；bestLagMs / jawRBestLag：±150 ms 内相关最大的时滞（正值 = 按音频的晚）和那时的相关。唇间隙：每个双唇音（P B M）中点那一帧，blendFace 合成后上下唇缘在中间 60% 上的最大竖直距离（毫米，CPU 参考实现），≤ 0.3 mm 算合上。时间线是自动对齐，不是人工标注。
method.en: Written by bun tools/voice/librispeech-demo.ts bench (see tools/voice/librispeech-bench.ts). Male body; by phoneme uses speech's default style, "normal". jawR: Pearson correlation of the jaw angle of the two modes (100 frames a second) over all frames; jawRSpeech: over speech frames only; bestLagMs / jawRBestLag: the lag within ±150 ms with the highest correlation (positive = the audio route is later) and that correlation. Lip gap: at the middle frame of every bilabial (P B M), the largest vertical distance between the upper and lower lip margins over the middle 60 % after blendFace (mm, CPU reference); ≤ 0.3 mm counts as sealed. The timelines are automatic alignments, not hand labels.
